variation: Machine donkey calf raise with roughly90degree hip hinge and lower-back loading pad, forefeet supported on raised step, full controlled ankle plantarflexion and dorsiflexion.
camera: Fixed side three-quarter facing left; heel clearance and lower-back pad visible.
equipment: Real donkey calf machine with forefoot step, fixed forward hand supports, vertical moving lower-back loading pad on a guided carriage.

beats.label: Set your stretch
beats.cue: Brace forward; let heels lower below platform.
beats.pose: Hips hinged approximately90degrees, balls of feet supported, heels below step, lower-back pad in contact.

beats.label: Rise through your toes
beats.cue: Lift heels while keeping knees softly straight.
beats.pose: Heels halfway raised, ankles plantarflexing; pelvis and loading pad rise together.

beats.label: Reach the top
beats.cue: Rise onto toes and squeeze your calves.
beats.pose: Heels fully raised in controlled range; forefeet remain on same step, pad contacts lower back.

beats.label: Control the top
beats.cue: Pause briefly without bouncing or bending knees.

beats.label: Lower slowly
beats.cue: Lower heels slowly against the resistance.

beats.label: Return to stretch
beats.cue: Let heels sink below the platform gently.
